content.name: Strong Wind
entries: Strong wind imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on ranged attack rolls with weapons. It also extinguishes open flames and disperses fog. A flying creature in a strong wind must land at the end of its turn or fall.
A strong wind in a desert can create a sandstorm that imposes Disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks.
